title: Above-average earners
statementMd:
List employees who earn **more than the company-wide average salary**.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compute the average in a subquery: `(SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees);
```

A scalar subquery returns a single value that can be compared against each row.

expected.query: SELECT first_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees);
